description: Na₅Mn₃S₄(O₄F)₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₅F octahedra, corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are two shorter (2.47 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.30 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.71 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.95 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.39 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form MnO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₅F octahedra, corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. Both Mn-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. There are two shorter (1.89 Å) and two longer (2.17 Å) Mn-F bond lengths. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to five O and one F atom to form MnO₅F octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one MnO₂F₄ octahedra, and corners with five SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-68°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.28 Å. The Mn-F bond length is 2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three equivalent MnO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-58°. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three MnO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-59°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.54 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mn and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form distorted FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Mn₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Mn₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid. In the second F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Mn atoms to form FNa₂Mn₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Mn₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid.
